{{Top|leg}}
'''The Free Access Grill''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] that was located on [[Central Avenue]] in [[Grig]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. Unlike the majority of other establishments on the planet, it welcomed and served [[Alien/Legends|aliens]]. It was run by the four-armed [[Tikiman]].<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
